title: 1700–1706 Prairie's front curb
items: The low stone curb now runs along the street line across the middle of the Glessner-Lee pair, between the two gates, where both photographs show the lawn held back with no iron on it.
The spear railings still stand only beyond each house's walk, as photographed: south of 1706's toward 1708, and north of 1700's.
